summary: Tested the preview-only Dev Login panel and the 4 seeded test-user Bearer tokens end-to-end. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_dev_login_tokens.py (13 tests, all passing) covering /api/auth/me plan state for free/trial/pro-monthly/pro-annual, trial_days_left, /api/me/entitlements role gating, 401 on missing/invalid token, and portfolio GET/PUT persistence. Frontend: Playwright verified the toggle+panel render bottom-left, all 4 user buttons work, each login lands on /account with correct email/plan (Free, Free trial - 7 days left, Pro - Monthly, Pro - Annual), Header shows avatar + PRO badge (no Sign In) for logged-in users, free user's /portfolio is limited to latest 5 bets with the upgrade banner, and Log out clears moka_session_token and returns to signed-out home. No console errors. All requested features work.

issues: Header nav 'Portfolio' badge shows the total bet count (7) while the free user can only see 5 entries - slightly inconsistent with the enforced free limit
Bet cards render 'vs' with blank team names / blank PICK when a bet record lacks home/away/pick fields (observed with synthetic seeded bets); a fallback label would be more robust

critical_code_review_comments: DevLoginPanel.jsx: data-testid="dev-login-panel" sits on the always-rendered outer wrapper, so it is present even when the panel is collapsed. Move it to the expanded panel div so tests can assert open/closed state.
DevLoginPanel.loginAs always redirects to /account, discarding the current route; acceptable for a dev helper but noted.
Panel does not highlight which test user is currently active (only shows the email line); a checkmark on the active row would reduce confusion when switching.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily PUT 7 TEST_ bets to free@moka.test portfolio to verify the 5-entry free limit; portfolio restored to empty afterwards. Seeded users already existed (no re-seed needed).
test_credentials: Bearer tokens: test-free-token, test-trial-token, test-pro-monthly-token, test-pro-annual-token (all valid, /api/auth/me returns 200)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Seeded tokens are live in the preview DB and return correct plan states; no re-seed needed. Dev Login panel (bottom-left) reliably switches users - use data-testid dev-login-toggle then dev-login-<token>, it does a full page replace to /account so re-wait for networkidle. Free user portfolio limit is enforced client-side (FREE_LIMIT=5 in PortfolioPage.jsx); backend /api/me/portfolio returns all entries. Real Google OAuth round-trip was not attempted (per request).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no defects found. One test failure during authoring was my own wrong payload shape for PUT /api/me/portfolio (expects flat {bets, tickets}, not nested {data}); test corrected.
